crossRefs.note: The days of Adam after he became the father of Seth were eight hundred years, and he became the father of other sons…

people.name: Methuselah
people.line: The oldest person mentioned in the Bible.

translations.web: Methuselah lived after he became the father of Lamech seven hundred eighty-two years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.
translations.bsb: And after he had become the father of Lamech, Methuselah lived 782 years and had other sons and daughters.
translations.kjv: And Methuselah lived after he begat Lamech seven hundred eighty and two years, and begat sons and daughters:
translations.asv: and Methuselah lived after he begat Lamech seven hundred eighty and two years, and begat sons and daughters.
